subject: Physics
source_note: TIE (2023), Physics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Apply knowledge of Physics in various contexts

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts, theories and principles of Physics
competences: (a) Describe the concept of waves and laws of motion (Waves, Newton’s laws of motion and linear momentum)
(b) Describe the concept and principles of equilibrium (moment of force, centre of gravity and types of equilibrium)
(c) Explain the concept and laws of friction (types of friction, laws of friction)
(d) Explain the principles of simple machines (lever, pulley, inclined plane, screw jack, wheel and axle, hydraulic press)

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concept of waves and laws of motion (Waves, Newton’s laws of motion and linear momentum)
objectives.teaching_methods: Digital interactive simulations, Practical Work, Brainstorming
objectives.resources: Text books, inclined plane and roller Strings, ripple tank, ICT-facilities, stroboscope, tuning forks, pipes, sonometer, resonance tube
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concepts of waves and laws of motion are correctly described

objectives.text: (b) Describe the concept and principles of equilibrium (moment of force, centre of gravity and types of equilibrium)
objectives.resources: Text books, other relevant materials and knife edge
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concepts and principles of equilibrium are described correctly

objectives.text: (c) Explain the concept and laws of friction (types of friction, laws of friction)
objectives.resources: Wooden block, rough surface, spring balance and standard masses
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concepts and laws of friction are explained clearly

objectives.text: (d) Explain the principles of simple machines (lever, pulley, inclined plane, screw jack, wheel and axle, hydraulic press)
objectives.resources: Pulleys, pair of scissors, wheel barrow, Spade and bottle opener
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concepts and principles of simple machines are explained correctly

sub_topics.title: Use mathematics to explain physical principles and phenomena
competences: (a) Apply mathematical knowledge to describe various principles and physical phenomena related to waves, Newton’s laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines)

objectives.text: (a) Apply mathematical knowledge to describe various principles and physical phenomena related to waves, Newton’s laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines)
objectives.resources: Meter rule, stop watch, spring balance, wooden bar and knife edge
objectives.assessment_criteria: Mathematical knowledge to describe various principles and physical phenomena are correctly applied

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic experimental skills in Physics
competences: (a) Describe types of experimental variables in physics related to motion
(b) Carry out scientific investigations related to waves, laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines

objectives.text: (a) Describe types of experimental variables in physics related to motion
(b) Carry out scientific investigations related to waves, laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines
objectives.assessment_criteria: Scientific investigations related to waves, laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines are carried out

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of data analysis, presentation and report writing in Physics
competences: (a) Use scientific report to communicate experimental results in Physics

objectives.text: (a) Use scientific report to communicate experimental results in Physics
objectives.assessment_criteria: A scientific report is correctly used to communicate experimental results in Physics

topics.title: Evaluate and use information in Physics

sub_topics.title: Collect, describe and relate physical data
competences: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical parameters (Waves, Newton’s laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines)
(b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to Newton’s laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines

objectives.text: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical parameters (Waves, Newton’s laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines)
objectives.resources: Online resources and other relevant materials
objectives.assessment_criteria: Collected physical data are correctly analysed to explain various physical parameters

objectives.text: (b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to Newton’s laws of motion, equilibrium, friction and simple machines
objectives.resources: Online resources and other relevant materials stop watch and trolley model
objectives.assessment_criteria: Collected physics data are correctly analysed to explain various physical quantities

sub_topics.title: Carry out a project in Physics
competences: (a) Develop and carry out a research project in Physics

objectives.text: (a) Develop and carry out a research project in Physics
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, Digital interactive simulation, Experimentation
objectives.resources: Online resources and other relevant materials
objectives.assessment_criteria: A research project in Physics is developed and carried out correctly
